text:
maya: Ok team — launch week + webinar week planning. Need X and LinkedIn cadence, short clips for carousel, and clear SDR routing for signups. Can we lock times and copy by EOD tomorrow?
liam: I can draft copy variants for both channels. Plan: 3 X posts (teaser, demo clip, webinar CTA) + 2 LinkedIn (longer thread + carousel). Will do short/long caption versions.
sofia: For engagement follow-ups: 1) comment replies within 30m 2) CTA to signup + link 3) SDR ping on HubSpot when lead signs up. I have follow-up message templates ready.
jake: On the HubSpot side I need UTM + form name to map to the right sequence. Can we standardize utm_source=xlnk_social, utm_campaign=prod_launch_Mar? Also cc me on the webhook setup.
anya: Assets: 3 short clips (15s, 30s), 1 hero PNG, 4 carousel panels for LinkedIn. I'll upload low/high res to Drive by 3pm. Any direction on aspect ratios?
liam: X: keep copy punchy (<240 chars), include 1 hashtag, 1 @mention of partners. LinkedIn: 2-3 paragraph thread + carousel alt text. Also recommend pinned thread on X with the webinar registration link.
maya: Good. Jake — can you confirm you can pick up inbound within 10 minutes for paid promos? We want to route paid leads to SDR priority.
jake: Yes — if we tag paid traffic with utm_medium=paid_social I can add priority flag in HubSpot. Need the final UTM scheme and the event name.
sofia: Draft follow-up snippets (short):
- "Thanks for signing up! Quick Q — what are you building with LLMs? Reply here and we'll share relevant examples."
- "Appreciate you signing up — an SDR will reach out in <24h for a quick intro. In meantime, here's a one-pager: <link>"
maya: Love those. Also need an engagement play for top replies: 1) react + reply within 1h, 2) drop clip or customer quote, 3) invite to take a quick poll.
engage-bot: Reminder — calendar slots for scheduling posts via social-console: Tue 09:00 PT, Tue 12:00 PT, Wed 08:00 PT. Only 2 carousel upload slots left.
liam: I'll A/B test two headline variants on X: (A) "Ship LLM features 10x faster" (B) "Make LLM inference predictable & cheap" — track CTR to webinar.
anya: Uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/assets (folder). Filenames: clip_15s.mp4, clip_30s.mp4, hero-1200x675.png, carousel_01.png..04.png
maya: Perfect. Can whoever schedules please include the UTMs Jake asked for and the tracking pixel for the webinar? 
jake: I'll share the HubSpot form name: "launch_webinar_march_v1" and the webhook endpoint to post lead JSON. Pasting UTM template: 
```
?utm_source=social&utm_medium={paid|organic}&utm_campaign=prod_launch_march&utm_content={post_variant}
```
sofia: For comment routing, use this quick mapping: "asks-pricing" -> sales-queue, "technical-implementation" -> solutions@redwood.ai, "partnership" -> partnerships@redwood.ai.
liam: One more ask — can design export a 1:1 square for in-feed previews and a 16:9 for X card? Helps with clipping.
anya: Yep. exporting now. ETA 2h.
maya: Thanks. Final checklist before EOD tomorrow:
- copy variants in doc (liam)
- assets uploaded (anya)
- UTMs + form name + webhook (jake)
- engagement templates + routing map (sofia)
- schedule confirmed and posts queued in social-console (maya/liam)
Ping here when done and I'll approve. :rocket:
